applicability: Branch protection settings for validate jobs; also LOOP-001 spec territory (release gates); recheck when branch protection changes.

evidence.environment: GitHub Actions, latent-sre/sde-agents main branch, 2026-08-02 to 2026-08-03
evidence.source_reference: gh run list on main 2026-08-03: merges #57, #58, #59, #68 all landed with validate(macos) failing; first green run restored by PR #72

expected_behavior: A red check on main either blocks merging via branch protection or is surfaced at merge time; a check that can be silently merged over provides no gate at all.
observation: Four consecutive merges landed over a failing required-intent CI check (macOS validate job red since #57) with no branch-protection enforcement and no reviewer noticing; the breakage was discovered only when an unrelated PR inherited the red check.

scope: Repository merge discipline and branch protection; not the content of any individual check.
